posts.zh:
dsh-workspace-explorer 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bfd6efc96b662ca0b401.html
posts.en:
dsh-workspace-explorer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bfd6efc96b662ca0b401.html
